sample_source: A total of 111 patients diagnosed with melanoma metastasis between 1975 and 2011 were evaluated in the study (Table 1).
age: Average age ± standard deviation (range) at diagnosis of lymph node metastasis was 62.4 ± 13.7 (25–89) years.
